scope_semantics.canvas: CPU processing; recording includes uploads and WGPU submission; tessellation includes mesh cache lookup
scope_semantics.canvas_text: synchronous Canvas text calls on the pass thread; total includes cache work and nested CPU stages; excludes engine lock wait, calls outside a pass and GPU work; bytes count newly produced final RGBA data only
scope_semantics.component_after_layout: entire root/recursive hook sweep; includes application Canvas painting; nested in layout_update
scope_semantics.fps: on-demand rendering; sample count/interval is not throughput or FPS
scope_semantics.layout_compute: aggregate runtime-owned LayoutEngine calls including overlay measurements and UI text; nested in layout_update
scope_semantics.pass: Tree::pass wall time; includes nested UI/layout/text/Canvas/render; excludes prior input dispatch
scope_semantics.render_encode: inclusive backend encoding; DX12 includes Canvas and atlas uploads; WGPU includes buffer/image uploads
scope_semantics.submit_present: CPU API wall time, not GPU execution
scope_semantics.ui_text: UI GlyphEngine only; excludes document CanvasTextEngine shaping
scope_semantics.ui_update: inclusive rebuild/refresh with nested commit; may precede or nest in a pass
